app/src/lib/pokedex.ts:123 — shared helpers (cardsForPokemon, humanize) stay alive; no dead code left

evidence: app/src/lib/api.ts:75 — spriteUrl is the single URL builder used by app/src/components/PokemonCard.astro:14, so a sprite fix covers all four card lists

app/src/lib/pokedex.ts:123-139 — but the card id/name itself is resolved here for 3 lists while the home page builds its own card data at app/src/pages/index.astro:29-30, so id-mapping fixes land in 2 places
app/src/pages/moves/[name].astro:24-27 and app/src/pages/abilities/[name].astro:13-16 — the 404 + effect-fallback chain (englishShortEffect ?? latestFlavorText ?? MISSING) is duplicated
app/src/pages/index.astro:103-112 and app/src/pages/pokemon/[name].astro:226-235 — the fetch/DOMParser/replaceWith client enhancement is duplicated, so behaviour changes need two edits
changeability.rationale: Most fixes have one obvious home (sprite URL, cache rules, card filtering), but a few cross-cutting concerns exist as two copies each — findable, but you must remember both.

evidence: app/src/components/CardGrid.astro:9-14 — components meet through a narrow typed Card interface, not each other's internals
app/src/scripts/sortable.ts:34-36 — client enhancement is driven purely by data-sortable/data-sort attributes via delegation; server and client code are cleanly separated
app/src/lib/pokedex.ts:61 — api() returns any, so raw API record shapes leak into page frontmatter (e.g. app/src/pages/pokemon/[name].astro:50-107, app/src/pages/types/[name].astro:21)
app/src/pages/index.astro:26 and app/src/pages/types/[name].astro:19 — both rebuild the type-label Map inline instead of using the typeLabels() helper at app/src/lib/pokedex.ts:53
coupling.rationale: Seams are clear and props are narrow, but the untyped data layer means every page hand-parses raw API records, and the type-label map is constructed in three slightly different ways.

evidence: app/src/lib/pokedex.ts:123-127 — cardsForPokemon's extra?: (ref) => Partial<Card> callback absorbs the hidden-ability variation (app/src/pages/abilities/[name].astro:17) without flag creep
app/src/components/Section.astro:6-10 — one small component gives every detail page the same section id/aria-labelledby contract
app/src/components/MovesTable.astro:14-24 — showLevel is a boolean keyed off the literal method name 'level-up'; a second level-bearing method would need more flag logic
app/src/pages/moves/[name].astro:18-33 vs app/src/pages/abilities/[name].astro:9-17 — detail-page scaffolding is copy-pasted rather than abstracted, which an Items section would inherit
abstraction_design.rationale: The core abstractions (Card, cardsForPokemon, Section, api cache) stretch to real variation well and are not over-general; the shortfall is the repeated detail-page pattern, which a fourth resource type would copy rather than reuse.

findings.issue: Detail-page scaffolding (parallel fetch + species index, 404 status, effect fallback englishShortEffect ?? latestFlavorText ?? MISSING, count + CardGrid section) is duplicated verbatim in abilities/[name].astro:9-17; a new resource type or a change to fallback rules must be copied N times.
findings.suggestion: Extract a lib-level helper (e.g. resourceDetail(resource, name) plus an effectOf(record) in lib/pokedex.ts) and optionally a small 'Pokémon cards section' component, so detail pages share one implementation.

findings.issue: The progressive-enhancement pattern (fetch URL, DOMParser, guard with a latest counter, replaceWith, fallback navigation) is duplicated in pokemon/[name].astro:226-235; changes to error handling, focus restoration or abort semantics need two synchronized edits.
findings.suggestion: Move a swapRegion(url, selector) helper into src/scripts/ alongside sortable.ts and call it from both pages.

findings.issue: The home page passes raw SpeciesEntry objects where Card is expected, relying on structural coincidence; card construction has two independent sources, so card-level fixes (e.g. which id a card carries) only cover the three cardsForPokemon lists.
findings.suggestion: Have index.astro build Cards explicitly (or make cardsForPokemon usable from the index) so every list derives from one code path.

findings.issue: api<T = any> returns untyped payloads, so raw API shapes are parsed in page frontmatter (pokemon/[name].astro:50-107, types/[name].astro:21-22), coupling every page to API internals.
findings.suggestion: Type the common records (species, pokemon, move, type, ability) in lib and shape them in lib/pokedex.ts, keeping pages working against named fields.

findings.issue: The type-label Map is rebuilt inline here and in types/[name].astro:19, duplicating the typeLabels() helper at lib/pokedex.ts:53 and threading a Map through three components.
findings.suggestion: Derive labels inside PokemonCard/TypeBadge from a single shared helper or the SpeciesIndex so the Map isn't threaded and rebuilt.

findings.issue: showLevel is a boolean hard-keyed to the method name 'level-up'; a level-bearing variant or a second special column needs more flag logic in the component.
findings.suggestion: Drive columns from the row data (e.g. a hasLevel computed by the caller and passed as part of the column config) instead of a name literal.

findings.issue: security.checkOrigin is set to false although the app only issues GET requests, silently weakening Astro's default CSRF protection for future form posts.
findings.suggestion: Remove the security block and re-enable the default; nothing in the app requires it.

summary: A tidy, idiomatic Astro 7 codebase where each feature is one route plus a self-contained section, and cross-cutting concerns (API base URL, caching, sprite URLs, card rendering) mostly have a single home. The costs are a copy-pasted detail-page pattern between moves and abilities, a duplicated client-side fetch-and-swap script, and an untyped data layer that makes every page dig into raw API records. Extending to a new resource type means cloning ~90 lines rather than reusing a loader.
